column1: # DoctKey acceptance fixtures — smart English fallback (and smart off).
# Format: method,mode,smart,tone_style <TAB> keys <TAB> expected document text
# smart ON: words that cannot be Vietnamese fall back to the literal keystrokes
# smart ON: a final repeated operator must not eat a letter of an English word
# smart ON: known English words keep their letters (no tone mark eats a key)
# smart ON: valid Vietnamese is kept (even if the keystrokes were accidental)
# smart OFF: the same keystrokes are always transformed
# VNI: an escaped word must not swallow following digits
